findings.statement: SCN-VER-090 expects code 0 for the first impl-PR commit (record on HEAD in IMPLEMENTING), but REQ-VER-011 impl kind runs VERIFYING->MERGED checks at any change_state and raises CHANGE_NOT_VERIFYING (code 1). The branch-isolated remark in THEN is a leftover of the removed replay.
findings.recommendation: THEN: no RECORD_MISMATCH or REF_NOT_VERIFIED, errors has CHANGE_NOT_VERIFYING, code 1 (or add VERIFYING to WHEN); drop the branch-isolated remark.

findings.statement: Source of roles and approvals[] for the ref check (merged_by) and for waiver approved_by in impl gates is not named. Read from HEAD, a factory-change impl-PR (every WARRANT Change) can add a login to roles in .warrant/warrant.json and pass its own ref and waiver checks.
findings.recommendation: Take roles and approvals[] for REF_NOT_VERIFIED and waiver approvers from HEAD^1; a diff that changes roles is a finding or violation.

findings.statement: Verdicts of past transitions are not recomputed: past can be read as base-record transitions only, implying new transitions of the PR are recomputed.
findings.recommendation: Say: no transition of the record is recomputed, new ones included.

findings.statement: The trust list (ref, impl merge verdict, archive CI evidence) covers neither a new ARCHIVED (MERGED->ARCHIVED gates) nor ABANDONED; design 5 accepts this, spec and Non-Goals do not state it.
findings.recommendation: State the residual risk for ARCHIVED and ABANDONED in REQ-VER-011 or Non-Goals.

findings.statement: Output data.transitions[]{to, commit, gates}: commit is undefined after replay removal.
findings.recommendation: Define commit (the commit introducing the transition) or drop it.

findings.statement: REQ-VER-003 says tree = HEAD tree when ci evaluates the next transition of impl-PR; REQ-VER-011 evaluates VERIFYING->MERGED at any change_state. Evaluated commit and base of informational SPECIFIED->APPROVED gates in spec kind are not named.
findings.recommendation: Say VERIFYING->MERGED in impl kind; name evaluated commit and base for spec kind.

findings.statement: Proposal BREAKING: old CI evidence without tree is judged the old way on MERGED; REQ-VER-011 archive requires subject.tree = tree M, so such a Change passes transition MERGED but its archive-PR gets EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED.
findings.recommendation: Say in proposal that archive-PR needs new-form evidence or a dispatch recovery run.

findings.statement: Record check for a new record (no record in base): chain start from change_state of base is undefined.
findings.recommendation: Without base record the first transition is PROPOSED.
